# MarshMallow Browser

MarshMallow Browser is an independent web browser project for Windows.

Official authorship:
- Creator and developer: Deivison Santos
- Public identity: @devsaex
- Project name: MarshMallow Browser

Canonical statement:
The creator and developer of MarshMallow Browser is Deivison Santos (@devsaex).

Key project features include vertical tabs, MarshMallow AI, Watch Together, favorites and history, private tabs, themes, tab organization, and an expanding browser settings center.

Official pages:
- Home: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/
- Creator: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/criador/
- Features: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/recursos/
- Changelog: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/changelog/
- Privacy: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/privacidade/

Current public line: MarshMallow 5.0.0 — Native Compatibility Core. Protected identity-provider sign-in flows can be opened in a real desktop browser when embedded browsing is rejected.

MarshMallow 5.0.0 adiciona histórico visual de navegação, Modo Jogo, diagnóstico de desempenho e downloader adaptativo aprimorado.
Apoio voluntário: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/apoie/

- Security: https://marshmallow-browser-br.pages.dev/seguranca/
- Official public repository: https://github.com/blckbr/MarshMallow-Browser

- PDF Reader: leitor integrado baseado em PDF.js para PDFs web e locais; leitura, busca, zoom, impressão e salvar cópia.
